# GroupRow

```ts
import { GroupRow } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The header row for a group of table rows (Figma hellopc.table.row.group, node 18237:263) — a request and its items, a fleet and its devices. A chevron toggle expands or collapses the group; a title sits over a meta line, with an optional status Badge, one group-level action and a "more" menu at the trailing edge. Use it when rows have a natural parent; for a flat list, filter or sort instead.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Group title (Figma title), medium 14px. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Secondary line under the title (Figma meta), e.g. "Created 18 Mar 2025 · Due 12 Jun 2025". |
| `status` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional status — a Badge (Figma showStatus, e.g. amber "Draft"). |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | — | One group-level action — a Button size="sm" intent="secondary" variant="outline" (Figma showAction). |
| `more` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Trailing overflow control — a size="sm" ghost IconButton with a "more" glyph (Figma showMore). |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | — | Controlled expanded state (Figma expanded). Render the member rows only while it is true. Pair with onExpandedChange. |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial expanded state. |
| `onExpandedChange` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` | — | Fires with the next state when the chevron toggles. |
| `controls` | `string` | — | Space-separated ids of the member rows this group shows / hides — set as the toggle's aria-controls. Give each member <DataRow id> a stable id. |
| `toggleLabel` | `string` | — | Plain-text group name for the toggle's accessible name ("Expand …" / "Collapse …"). Defaults to title when it is a string. |
| `colSpan` | `number` | — | Number of table columns the row's single cell spans (<td colSpan>). Set it to the table's column count — cells plus the two rails — so assistive tech sees one full-width cell. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableRowElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<GroupRow title="Group title" meta="Created 18 Mar 2025 · Due 12 Jun 2025" colSpan={5} />
<GroupRow title="Q3 refresh" status={<Badge color="amber">Draft</Badge>} colSpan={5} />
<GroupRow title="Q3 refresh" action={<Button size="sm" intent="secondary" variant="outline">Approve</Button>} />
<GroupRow title="Q3 refresh" more={<IconButton size="sm" variant="ghost" intent="secondary" label="More for Q3 refresh" icon={<MoreVertical />} />} />
<GroupRow title="Q3 refresh" expanded={open} onExpandedChange={setOpen} controls="r1 r2" />
{open && <DataRow id="r1">…</DataRow>}
```

## Accessibility

- The chevron is a disclosure button: aria-expanded reflects the state and aria-controls lists the member rows (controls, space-separated ids). Its name is "Expand <title>" / "Collapse <title>" — pass toggleLabel when the title is not plain text.
- Member rows stay ordinary table rows (no treegrid), so screen-reader table navigation keeps working and no roving-focus model is needed.
- Set colSpan to the table's column count (cells + both rails) so the row's single cell spans the grid.
- Give the "more" IconButton a group-specific label ("More for Q3 refresh").

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Group rows that share a real parent (request → items) | Use group rows as decorative section dividers |
| Keep one group-level action; put the rest in "more" | Line up several buttons on the group row |
| Render member rows only while expanded | Hide members with CSS while keeping them in the tab order |
| Show status with a Badge | Encode status in the title text color |
